name: Minnesota Meetup III Thursday 2024
information:
This competition is a series competition with:

* [Minnesota Meetup III Tuesday 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaMeetupIIITuesday2024) 
* [Minnesota Meetup III Wednesday 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaMeetupIIIWednesday2024)

***You may only compete in one of these competitions.*** 

At this competition, only the top three newcomers in each event will receive awards.

[Please click here for more info about series competitions.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaMeetupIIITuesday2024#33917-series-competitions-faq)
